featured_reviews.name: Hiren Mirani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our experience with the Ghatkopar franchise has been extremely pathetic, frightening, and deeply distressing. The commitments made before onboarding were completely misrepresented once the service began.

We were promised continuous supervision, qualified nurse support, and doctor oversight. However, the most alarming issue was that fake vitals were recorded and reported by their nurse, which directly endangered the patient’s safety and violated basic medical ethics.

When we consulted external doctors in the patient’s best interest, the franchise withdrew supervision entirely, which is unacceptable and irresponsible. This clearly exposed a serious internal communication and accountability failure between the nurse, supervisor, and leadership.

Instead of addressing these life-threatening concerns, we were met with disrespectful and insensitive behaviour from the supervisor and leadership team, showing zero empathy toward a family already under extreme emotional stress. The harassment and mental trauma caused due to their mismanagement is something no family should have to endure.

Given the false medical reporting, lack of supervision, and unprofessional conduct, this franchise cannot be trusted with patient care. We strongly warn others to exercise extreme caution before engaging their services.

Personalized diet plans help seniors maintain energy, manage medical conditions, support immunity, and enjoy meals tailored to their unique health needs. At Sahabhaav, nutritious meals are thoughtfully planned according to each resident’s clinical requirements, ensuring both wellness and comfort every day.

Caring for a loved one is rewarding, but caregivers also need time to rest and recharge. featured_reviews.name: Deepa Arjunan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Team Sahabhaav took good care of my 76-year-old, diabetic, bed-bound mother with multiple health issues. Excellent nurses whose meticulous care made a huge difference. Well-trained cheerful mavshis and quietly efficient mamas, good cooks serving timely, tasty, nutritious meals, a kind and patient physiotherapist, lively management, wide range of activities for mental and physical well-being. Vibrant festive celebrations, music, games, outdoor visits. A positive atmosphere, a personal touch. Full infrastructure, airbeds, oxygen, IV and equipment.
We want the best for our loved ones, especially in their sunset years, but it is very difficult to do all this at home. People rarely talk about this. Finding the kind of comprehensive support and 24x7 service that Team Sahabhaav provided, lightened my physical and mental load.
I recommend Sahabhaav for eldercare. The world needs more Sahabhaavs!

featured_reviews.name: Satya Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our parents recently spent a short stay at Sahabhaav, and we were deeply impressed by the warmth, attentiveness, and professionalism of the entire team. The facility is modern, cheerful, and comfortable, the food was excellent, and the social activities helped our parents feel engaged and included. Minor issues were addressed promptly, creating a sense of ease throughout their stay. What stood out most is the genuine care that defines Sahabhaav. It is clear that for Dr Mini Panicker and her team, this work is truly a calling. Details on different aspects follow.

Exceptional Team and Warmth:
The staff's engagement made a tremendous difference. Our parents repeatedly said, "Anything we asked for, they got for us," which reflects how well they were looked after.

Social Interaction and Activities:
The range of activities, from casual storytelling sessions to aarti and seated garba, added real value. These thoughtful experiences help seniors feel connected and uplifted, especially those with limited mobility.

Facilities and Ambience:
The interiors have been newly renovated with a modern, airy, cheerful aesthetic that creates a welcoming atmosphere. The bathrooms are well designed with modern fittings and pleasant colors.

Food and Dining:
The meals were another highlight. Dad enjoyed the variety of vegetarian dishes, lentils, yogurt, buttermilk, and the occasional chicken. Mom, who is usually a selective eater, also managed very well, which speaks to the quality of the food and the adaptability of tastes.

Freedom From Household Responsibilities:
For Mom, the relief from day to day household tasks was meaningful. She appreciated being cared for rather than needing to manage everything herself.

Responsiveness:
As with any new place and the specific needs of individual guests, minor issues can arise, but what stood out was how promptly and proactively the Sahabhaav team addressed them.

Overall Experience:
Our parents' stay was overwhelmingly positive, and we are grateful for the compassion and professionalism shown throughout. Sahabhaav offers a warm, community driven environment that places seniors' comfort and dignity at the center. We deeply appreciate the efforts of everyone at Sahabhaav and wish the facility continued success and its residents the very best.
